summary: Northern Minerals & Exploration Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding its entry into a Memorandum of Understanding to acquire a 5.4165 net mineral acre leasehold interest in Garvin County, Oklahoma, from R.A. Miller Energy, Inc. The consideration is $21,666 total, comprising $10,833 cash (due by July 31, 2026) and 216,660 shares valued at $10,833. The leasehold carries a 77% net revenue interest. The company must also participate in a force pooling order for the Bosworth well. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is small, with no premium or regulatory clock indicated. The cash-and-stock consideration suggests a straightforward asset acquisition, not a tender or going-private. Watch for completion of the pooling order and drilling commitments.
